integrity: Proof gives the global real-simplex reduction and analytic classification. Numerical tests are illustrative and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite seven-cycle family at Schatten exponent four; other dimensions and exponents are not claimed. Novelty against undiscovered equivalent quadratic-programming treatments is a residual risk.
title: Two spectral thresholds and all minimizers of the seven-cycle weighted Schatten-fourth radius
